html.content:
Recommended

Heatmapscore: 0.95

Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.

Clinical use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap

  • 2 cats as row/col + numeric value
  • many numeric vars → matrix view
  • enough rows for matrix

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

Best for visualizing the values of multiple numeric features

Alternatives

Boxplotscore: 0.9

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group
  • sufficient n for box stats
  • multiple numeric vars

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Scatter2Dscore: 0.9

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • colour by category
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

Scatter3Dscore: 0.85

3D scatter for three continuous dimensions.

Clinical use: Multivariate exploratory analysis

  • 3 numeric → x/y/z scatter
  • colour by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='3D scatter of <num1> vs <num2> vs <num3>'

Treemapscore: 0.85

Nested rectangles sized by value — hierarchical proportion.

Clinical use: Hierarchical AE counts (SOC → PT)

  • cat + numeric → hierarchical size
  • nested hierarchy
  • many categories → treemap handles well

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='treemap of <numeric> by <factor> hierarchy'
